items.name: Anula Jayasuriya
bio: Founding Managing Partner of four investment funds: EXXclaim Capital, Evolvence India Life Science Fund I and II, and Kidron Capital.
Exited three Women’s Health Investments. Co-founder of Artemis Women’s Health Foundation, and Vice Chair of WHAM. Former Vice President at Roche Pharmaceuticals.
Board member of several private Women’s Health companies, and two publicly listed entities.

items.name: Maria Gajda Horowitz
bio: Experienced in deal-making, venture capital investments, fund formation, and fundraising. Active in VC investments since 2011. Involved with prestigious funds in fund formations in Europe and Israel. Led negotiations for investment agreements, asset acquisitions in healthcare, and a successful IPO in Europe. Board member of several medical device companies.

text: Shifting the paradigm in chemotherapy via a novel, vascular port, accomplishing both ease of placement and aesthetic sensibilities of female patients.
Developing a breakthrough technology to restore ovulation in women with PCOS, a condition affecting 10% of women of child-bearing age.
items.investors: Notable co-investors: Sofinnova Partners, Bpifrance, Trill Impact

text: Addressing the increased susceptibility of women developing acute kidney injury (AKI) following cardiac surgery. The technology is on the market and generating significant sales in Saudi Arabia and Europe.
Leveraging clinically demonstrated insights on age related mitochondrial dysfunction to rejuvenate skin.
**Collaborations** with high-end longevity clinics in Switzerland and the Nordics.

Advancing maternal health via a novel self-retaining surgical retractor specifically designed to address the unique challenges of C-sections, which are the most common surgeries in the world, particularly for women with high BMI.
items.investors: Notable co-investors: EQT Life Sciences, Texas Medical Center Venture Fund
